Multi-Locus Summary of Per-ICR Deviations

Source: R/module_icr.R
SummarizeICRStatus.Rd

Summarizes AnalyzeICRStatus() output per sample: the numbers of ICRs scored and called altered (gains and losses), the altered ICRs and their chromosomes, and a multi-locus flag. A sample is flagged MLID when its altered ICRs lie on at least min_chromosomes different chromosomes, so that neighbouring ICRs of one locus (for example the two DIRAS3 DMRs) count once.

Usage

SummarizeICRStatus(
  icr_table,
  min_chromosomes = 2L,
  dmr_type = NULL,
  exclude_icrs = "VTRNA2-1:DMR"
)

Arguments

icr_table

Output of AnalyzeICRStatus().

min_chromosomes

Minimum number of chromosomes with an altered ICR for the multi-locus flag (default 2).

dmr_type

Optional DMR_type values to summarize, for example "gametic"; NULL (default) uses every ICR in the table.

exclude_icrs

ICRs left out of the counts and the multi-locus flag. The default excludes VTRNA2-1:DMR (nc886), a polymorphically imprinted, metastable DMR that is unmethylated in a sizeable fraction of healthy individuals. Its per-ICR deviations stay in the AnalyzeICRStatus() table. Use NULL to count every ICR.

Value

Data frame with one row per sample: n_icrs, n_altered, n_gain, n_loss, n_altered_chromosomes, altered_icrs, MLID, and max_abs_deviation.
